title: Combined Anodal Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation (tDCS) and Cognitive Training and Decision-making
official: The Use of Combined Anodal Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation (tDCS) and Cognitive Training to Modulate Decision-making in Healthy People
summary: This study aims to (i) assess the effects of combined tDCS and cognitive training on decision-making on a trained task (Iowa Gambling Task; IGT); and (ii) test generalization to a closely related cognitive domain, namely motor impulsivity. It is hypothesized that combined anodal tDCS and cognitive training will result in more advantageous decisions and better impulse control than combined sham tDCS and cognitive training.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Consenting volunteers aged between 18 and 40.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals with epilepsy, other neurological conditions and history of significant head injury will be excluded.
* Individuals with a history of substance misuse, major mental disorder and those receiving psychotropic medication will be also excluded.
